subject.title: Expose per-surface agent/session routing for Talk realtime consults (talk.realtime.agentSession), mirroring channels.discord.voice.agentSession

question: Should realtime Talk gain a supported `talk.realtime.agentSession` contract with isolated per-node defaults, or should this behavior be delivered through an existing generic routing/configuration seam instead?
rationale: The request introduces a user-facing configuration and session-ownership policy; the supplied evidence shows a plausible need but does not determine the permanent public contract or default upgrade behavior.

options.title: Adopt a Talk routing contract
options.body: Specify a Talk-owned session-routing field that follows the established target model and makes isolated per-node sessions the default.

options.title: Extend a generic routing seam
options.body: Expose the required routing through a shared agent/session binding mechanism only if it can target Talk without duplicate configuration or weaker isolation guarantees.

options.title: Defer pending architecture review
options.body: Keep the report open until the Talk and session-routing owners confirm the desired ownership boundary and compatibility policy.

recommendation.title: Adopt a Talk routing contract
recommendation.body: Specify a Talk-owned session-routing field that follows the established target model and makes isolated per-node sessions the default.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context identifies the reporter as the only named person with a concrete reproduction and desired operational outcome; source-history ownership could not be confirmed from the review context.
